primary_rule: Each Monday 00:00 UTC, rank BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP by the prior-only 7-day mean of real Binance spot taker-buy volume ratio. Allocate 100% to the highest-ranked asset at that day's open, rebalance weekly, and deduct 15 bps one-way cost on each entry/exit/switch. No same-bar signal execution.
